Remove.</font></p></li><li><p><font style="font-size: 11px;"><strong>Request Format:</strong> JSON (<code>Content-Type: application/json</code>); CSV upload uses <code>multipart/form-data</code>.</font></p></li><li><p><font style="font-size: 11px;"><strong>Success Response:</strong> <code>{ "success": true, "data": {...} }</code></font></p></li><li><p><font 11px;"><strong>HTTP Status:</strong> 200 OK, 201 Created, 400 Bad Request, 401 Unauthorized, 403 Forbidden, 404 Not Found, 409 Conflict, 500 Internal Error.</font></p></li><li><p><font style="font-size: 11px;"><strong>Authentication:</strong> <code>Authorization: Bearer &lt;JWT&gt;</code> for protected endpoints.</font></p></li><li><p><font style="font-size: 11px;"><strong>Consistency:</strong> Same URL conventions, request/response structure, and error handling across all API modules.</font></p></li></ul>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="558" width="220"
